ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AMJ Land Holdings Limited has filed its routine quarterly compliance certificates under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE. This filing, certified by their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, confirms the proper handling and reconciliation of dematerialized and rematerialized securities. The document indicates standard regulatory adherence with no material impacts or red flags identified, being a typical procedural filing.
